notes: A078008_farey: in row n (2^n fractions, row 0 = 1/2) of the Stern-Brocot tree of (0,1) the number of even denominators is A078008(n). Key: neighbours a/b<c/d with bc-ad=1; children dens = d, b mod 2, so E(n+1) = 2^n - E(n). Reading: full tree of (0,inf) would give A001045 instead. Outside Lean: g.f. -> recurrence; the reading of 'infinite Farey row'.
